title: TETHER portable bundle v1 shapes
description: The root validates bundle.json. Other JSON objects use the named $defs (portable_inputs, case_v2, evidence_v2, derivation_v1, run, ledger, FeatureVector, Prediction, trace_event). This source-only schema adds no runtime dependency. Shape validation is not execution, temporal/source proof, scientific validation, archival authenticity or certification of arbitrary prose. Enable format assertion for calendar and date-time checks; runtime remains authoritative. JSON Schema integer accepts mathematically integral numbers; strict runtime decoding also checks original parsed numeric types.

json_value.description: Ordinary JSON only. Runtime also rejects duplicate keys and non-finite numbers; these cannot be proven by a post-parse shape schema.

logical_path.description: Relative slash-separated path with 1–120-character components. Runtime additionally enforces NFC, Windows reserved-device rejection, casefold uniqueness, file/link safety and actual confinement.

Derivation.description: Descriptor shape only. Registry support, exact implementation and parameter pins, input closure, output equality and method chronology require the runtime. Unknown methods may remain inspectable without replay.

Snapshot.description: Portable snapshot: no machine-specific raw root. Runtime verifies combined source/artifact bounds, complete eligible closure, matching origins, role policy and receipt availability.

catalog_policy.description: Retained catalog metadata is intentionally extensible; runtime checks exact allowed dataset roles and denies evaluator-only dependencies.

manifest.description: bundle.json. Runtime additionally checks the 1 MiB encoded manifest cap, logical total <=256 MiB, same-digest size equality, casefold path aliases, exact source closure, source-tier policy, content hashes and semantic replay. A supplied digest is not independent authenticity or a trusted timestamp.

run.description: Portable run.json shape. Runtime checks the journal, category ordering, usage sums, cases/snapshot/configuration identity, source-derived coverage and recomputed deterministic features/scorer contributions.
